ash: ashley here — check from product: a couple enterprise tenants reported slow responses & a retry cascade, but not widespread. they hit higher latency for ~2-3m.

mike: agree. oncall plan: 1) reduce probe rate 30s -> 90s 2) increase debounce window 3 -> 6 consecutive failures to alert 3) raise transient-error threshold 3% -> 6%

-  - name: eu-embed
-     interval: 30s
-     failure_threshold: 3
-     error_rate_threshold: 0.03

+  - name: eu-embed
+    interval: 90s
+    failure_threshold: 6
+    error_rate_threshold: 0.06
```
